description: This file contains the implementation of engine control logic for a vehicle engine management system, including classes and functions for warning management, sensor updates, fuel consumption, engine state, and related functionalities.

classes.name: WarningCodeState
classes.description: Manages engine warning codes, their states, and warning timing.

classes.name: MockAdcState
classes.description: Provides mock ADC readings for testing purposes.

classes.name: FuelConsumptionState
classes.description: Tracks fuel consumption over different intervals.

classes.name: TransmissionState
classes.description: Represents the state of the vehicle transmission.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Maintains engine-related parameters and handles periodic updates.

classes.name: StartupFuelPumping
classes.description: Controls startup fuel priming pulses based on engine state.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::clear
methods.description: Resets the warning code state to initial values.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::addWarningCode
methods.description: Adds a new warning code to the warning state.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::isWarningNow
methods.description: Checks if a warning is active at the given time.

methods.name: MockAdcState::setMockVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage for a given ADC channel.

methods.name: FuelConsumptionState::addData
methods.description: Adds duration data to fuel consumption calculations.

methods.name: FuelConsumptionState::update
methods.description: Updates fuel consumption metrics based on current time.

methods.name: EngineState::periodicFastCallback
methods.description: Performs fast periodic updates of engine state.

methods.name: StartupFuelPumping::setPumpsCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter for startup fuel pumps.

methods.name: StartupFuelPumping::update
methods.description: Updates startup fuel pumping logic based on engine state.

methods.name: printCurrentState
methods.description: Outputs current engine state info to log.
